description: This file implements a semantic cache for language model responses using Redis as a backend, with support for both synchronous and asynchronous operations and integration of embedding models for semantic similarity searches.

classes.name: RedisSemanticCache
classes.description: A Redis-backed semantic cache class that performs semantic similarity-based caching of LLM responses, supporting both sync and async operations, with embedding generation and cache lookup methods.

methods.name: __init__( self, host: Optional[str] = None, port: Optional[str] = None, password: Optional[str] = None, redis_url: Optional[str] = None, similarity_threshold: Optional[float] = None, embedding_model: str = "text-embedding-ada-002", index_name: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the RedisSemanticCache with Redis connection parameters, similarity threshold, embedding model, and index name.

methods.name: Optional[int] _get_ttl(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL (time-to-live) for cache entries, if specified.

methods.name: List[float] _get_embedding(self, prompt: str)
methods.description: Generates an embedding vector for a prompt using the configured embedding model.

methods.name: Any _get_cache_logic(self, cached_response: Any)
methods.description: Processes cached responses for retrieval, handling decoding from bytes/string and parsing JSON to Python objects.

methods.name: None set_cache(self, key: str, value: Any, **kwargs)
methods.description: Stores a response in the semantic cache associated with a prompt derived from provided messages.

methods.name: Any get_cache(self, key: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a semantically similar cached response based on prompt messages.

methods.name: List[float] _get_async_embedding(self, prompt: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an embedding vector for a prompt, possibly routing through a proxy based on model configuration.

methods.name: None async_set_cache(self, key: str, value: Any, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously stores a response in the semantic cache.

methods.name: Any async_get_cache(self, key: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache response based on semantic similarity.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _index_info(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves info about the Redis index.

methods.name: None async_set_cache_pipeline( self, cache_list: List[Tuple[str, Any]], **kwargs )
methods.description: Asynchronously stores multiple cache entries in parallel.
